C0726.title: Real-World Data Poisoning Cases: Microsoft Tay Chatbot and Others
C0726.summary: The article lists several real-world data poisoning cases: Microsoft's Twitter chatbot Tay became offensive after a coordinated attack; spammers attempted to skew Gmail's spam classifier; and a study on autonomous driving systems found that attackers could deceive AI by inserting forged data label pairs, such as replacing stop signs with speed limit signs, leading to incorrect vehicle decisions.

references.title: Prevention Strategies and Countermeasures for Data Poisoning Attacks in the AI Era
